Figure 3A umap

depots_STx_adipocyte <- readRDS("~/zjw/20221005_Depots/STx_RDS/depots_STx_manully_select_removediffusion_harmony_new_with_deconvolution_adipocyte_20250129.RDS")
DefaultAssay(depots_STx_adipocyte) <- "Spatial"
depots_STx_adipocyte <- NormalizeData(depots_STx_adipocyte)
depots_STx_adipocyte <- ScaleData(depots_STx_adipocyte)
## Centering and scaling data matrix
Idents(depots_STx_adipocyte) <- factor(Idents(depots_STx_adipocyte) %>% as.character(),levels = c("AdipoLEP", "AdipoPLIN", "AdipoSAA"))

p1 <- DimPlot(depots_STx_adipocyte,pt.size = 0.7) + 
  # NoLegend() +
  NoAxes() +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#EEB84C", "#E6764F", "#69A785"))

p2 <- Plot_Density_Custom(depots_STx_adipocyte, features = c("LEP")) + NoAxes() + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
p3 <- Plot_Density_Custom(depots_STx_adipocyte, features = c("PLIN1")) + NoAxes() + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
p4 <- Plot_Density_Custom(depots_STx_adipocyte, features = c("SAA1")) + NoAxes() + theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

p <- (p1 | p2 | p3 | p4)

print(p)

Figure 3B Dotplot

Jesper_baseline <- readRDS("~/zjw/20221121_Ravi_Shah/Jesper_et_al_baseline.RDS")
DefaultAssay(Jesper_baseline) <- "Spatial"
Jesper_baseline_adipocyte <- subset(x = Jesper_baseline, idents = c("C03-Adipocyte LEP","C04-Adipocyte PLIN","C06-Adipocyte SAA"), invert = F)
Idents(Jesper_baseline_adipocyte) <- factor(Idents(Jesper_baseline_adipocyte) %>% as.character(),levels = c("C06-Adipocyte SAA","C04-Adipocyte PLIN","C03-Adipocyte LEP"))
DefaultAssay(Jesper_baseline_adipocyte) <- "Spatial"

Jesper_baseline_adipocyte <- NormalizeData(Jesper_baseline_adipocyte)
Jesper_baseline_adipocyte <- ScaleData(Jesper_baseline_adipocyte)
## Centering and scaling data matrix
p1 <- DotPlot(depots_STx_adipocyte, features = c("LEP", "CSDE1", "TNS1", "PLIN1", "PLIN4", "ADIPOQ", "SAA1", "SAA2", "CES1"),assay = "Spatial",col.min = -1.16,col.max = 1.16) +
  theme(axis.line.x=element_line(linetype=1,color="black"),
        axis.line.y=element_line(linetype=1,color="black"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face = "plain",size = 13,angle=90,hjust = 1,vjust = 0.5,colour = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "plain",size = 12,colour = "black"),
        legend.position="right") +
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(n = 7, name ="PRGn"))(51))
## Warning: Scaling data with a low number of groups may produce misleading results
## Scale for colour is already present.
## Adding another scale for colour, which will replace the existing scale.
p1$data$id <- factor(p1$data$id, levels = c("AdipoSAA", "AdipoPLIN", "AdipoLEP"))

p2 <- DotPlot(Jesper_baseline_adipocyte, features = c("LEP", "CSDE1", "TNS1", "PLIN1", "PLIN4", "ADIPOQ", "SAA1", "SAA2", "CES1"),assay = "Spatial",col.min = -1.16,col.max = 1.16) +
  theme(axis.line.x=element_line(linetype=1,color="black"),
        axis.line.y=element_line(linetype=1,color="black"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face = "plain",size = 13,angle=90,hjust = 1,vjust = 0.5,colour = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "plain",size = 12,colour = "black"),
        legend.position="right") +
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(n = 7, name ="PRGn"))(51))
## Warning: Scaling data with a low number of groups may produce misleading results
## Scale for colour is already present.
## Adding another scale for colour, which will replace the existing scale.
p2$data$id <- as.character(p2$data$id)
p2$data$id[p2$data$id=="C06-Adipocyte SAA"] <- "AdipoSAA" 
p2$data$id[p2$data$id=="C04-Adipocyte PLIN"] <- "AdipoPLIN"
p2$data$id[p2$data$id=="C03-Adipocyte LEP"] <- "AdipoLEP"
p2$data$id <- factor(p2$data$id, levels = c("AdipoSAA", "AdipoPLIN", "AdipoLEP"))

lim_size  <- range(c(p1$data$pct.exp,        p2$data$pct.exp),        na.rm = TRUE)
lim_color <- range(c(p1$data$avg.exp.scaled, p2$data$avg.exp.scaled), na.rm = TRUE)

cols <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "PRGn"))(51)

size_breaks  <- c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100)             
color_breaks <- pretty(lim_color, n = 3)

p1u <- p1 +
  scale_size(limits = lim_size, range = c(1, 6), breaks = size_breaks) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours = cols, limits = lim_color, breaks = color_breaks) +
  guides(
    size   = guide_legend(title = "pct.exp"),
    colour = guide_colourbar(title = "avg.exp.scaled")
  )
## Scale for size is already present.
## Adding another scale for size, which will replace the existing scale.
## Scale for colour is already present.
## Adding another scale for colour, which will replace the existing scale.
p2u <- p2 +
  scale_size(limits = lim_size, range = c(1, 6), breaks = size_breaks) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(colours = cols, limits = lim_color, breaks = color_breaks) +
  guides(
    size   = guide_legend(title = "pct.exp"),
    colour = guide_colourbar(title = "avg.exp.scaled")
  )
## Scale for size is already present.
## Adding another scale for size, which will replace the existing scale.
## Scale for colour is already present.
## Adding another scale for colour, which will replace the existing scale.
print(p1u + p2u)

Figure 3C

df <- data.frame()
for (i in unique(depots_STx_adipocyte$slide_id)) {
  temp <- depots_STx_adipocyte$SCT_snn_res.1.2[depots_STx_adipocyte$slide_id==i]
  df <- rbind(df,
              data.frame(slide_id=i,
                         percentage=c(length(temp[temp=="AdipoLEP"]),length(temp[temp=="AdipoPLIN"]),length(temp[temp=="AdipoSAA"]))/length(temp),
                         type=c("AdipoLEP","AdipoPLIN","AdipoSAA"),
                         Tissue.type=unique(depots_STx_adipocyte$Tissue.type[depots_STx_adipocyte$slide_id==i])))
  
}


df_new <- matrix(nrow = length(unique(df$Tissue.type)),ncol = length(unique(df$type)))
rownames(df_new) <- unique(df$Tissue.type)
colnames(df_new) <- unique(df$type)


for (row in rownames(df_new)) {
  for (col in colnames(df_new)) {
    df_new[row,col] <- median(df$percentage[df$Tissue.type==row & df$type==col])
  }
}

df_new <- df_new[c("subcutaneous", "omental", "mesenteric duodenum", "mesenteric colon", "epiploic"),c("AdipoLEP", "AdipoPLIN", "AdipoSAA")]
rownames(df_new) <- c("sc", "om", "ms", "mc", "epi")


p <- pheatmap::pheatmap(mat = df_new,
               cluster_cols = F,
               cluster_rows = F,
               scale = "column",
               name = "Scaled expression",
               cellwidth = 15,
               cellheight = 15,
               display_numbers = F,
               treeheight_col = 15,
               treeheight_row = 15,
               main = "STx percentage",
               silent = T,
               show_colnames = T,
               color = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(n = 7, name ="PRGn"))(51)[26:51],
               breaks = seq(-1.5,1.5,3/26)
) %>% as.ggplot()

print(p)

Figure 3D

depots_STx <- readRDS("data/depots_STx.RDS")
DefaultAssay(depots_STx) <- "Spatial"
depots_STx <- NormalizeData(depots_STx)
depots_STx <- ScaleData(depots_STx)
## Centering and scaling data matrix
Idents(depots_STx) <- "Tissue.type"
ave_exp <- AverageExpression(depots_STx, assays = "Spatial", slot = "data")
ave_exp <- ave_exp$Spatial[c("CES1", "SAA1", "SAA2"), c("sc", "om", "md", "mc", "epi")]
colnames(ave_exp) <- c("sc", "om", "ms", "mc", "epi")
ave_exp <- t(ave_exp)

p1 <- pheatmap::pheatmap(mat = ave_exp[,c("SAA1", "SAA2", "CES1")],
                         cluster_cols = F,
                         cluster_rows = F,
                         scale = "column",
                         name = "STx",
                         cellwidth = 15,
                         cellheight = 15,
                         display_numbers = F,
                         treeheight_col = 15,
                         treeheight_row = 15,
                         main = "STx",
                         silent = T,
                         show_colnames = T,
                         color = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(n = 7, name ="PRGn"))(51)[1:51],
                         breaks = seq(-1.5,1.5,3/51)
) %>% as.ggplot()
